justification: Both surfaces present a schematic humanoid presence rendered by shallow linear/relief carving with bilateral symmetry, and both include simple ring or disc motifs among curvilinear lines, but these are generic traits. A shows a single faint outspread stick-like figure with limbs, while B shows a sculpted head and torso whose back bears a structured set of paired rings, a central ring, arched motifs and a horizontal belt band — a much more organised, composite arrangement of discrete symbols that has no counterpart in A.
